test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which of the following states is the Mathuri folk dance practiced?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Telangana.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mathuri folk dance** is an important traditional dance of **Telangana, **reflecting the cultural heritage and social practices of the region.
 
• The dance is typically performed **during festivals and celebrations,** showcasing the joy and communal spirit of the local people.
 
• Traditional musical instruments such as** drums and flutes** accompany the dance, enhancing its energetic and festive atmosphere.
 
• The other folk dances of Telangana are **Gussadi dance, Dhimsa dance, Lambadi dance, Perini Sivatandavam, and Dappu dance.**
